report.assumptionsNotes: 15 ktpd design; 24-month construction; 3-month commissioning and 12-month ramp-up; 30-year mine life; 33-year project life including re-processing of existing heap-leach-pad ore; 8-year closure period; 355 operating days/year; Au US$2,500/oz; AUD:USD 0.66:1 during construction/commissioning and 0.67:1 over project life; annual cash flows assumed at year-end; no inflation/escalation; gold sold in period produced; 30% Australian Commonwealth corporate tax; Northern Territory royalty 3.5% of total gold sales; JAAC 1% plus 2% sliding component at report deck; Wheaton 1.13% then reduced by one-third after 3.47 Moz. Table 162 annualizes -2,-1,1-15. Table 163 only publishes grouped Years 16-43, so every physical/economic group total is evenly allocated across its constituent years by explicit user-approved approximation. No balancing item is introduced.
